title: The enablement matrix contradicts itself
text: The enablement matrix contradicts itself: the outcome forbids exposing the raw unrecognized value, but the required action says to record that value. This security-sensitive record contract must consistently require recording only that the value was unrecognized.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in f9d97a5, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
